name: 14432 · Clifton Spgs, NY
findings: ZIP 14432 (Clifton Spgs) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14432 (Clifton Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
